protocol.fit: Original 28746 training pairs for refits/continuation; previously saved early-validation filters for ensembles
protocol.guard: No lost original classifier true pair AND no lost original full-chain true pair; unchanged safety net and tiers
protocol.selection: One winner per family by validation false alerts, then simpler name; require no classifier/system true losses on validation
protocol.test: Existing historical audit has already been inspected. Freeze all family winners before loading it. Never choose an unselected diagnostic using test outcomes.
protocol.limitations: Exploratory repeated benchmark. No guarantee of no lost future conflicts.
protocol.source: Conservative conjunctions, margins and veto design are our own design, not a published guarantee.
